definitions.description: Add fields to telemetry records, when a condition holds.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: OTTL condition that has to hold for the fields to be added to a record. Without it, they are added to every record.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Where the field lives.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the field within the location. A name that starts with a bracket, such as ["labels"]["tier"], reaches into a map that is the value of a key.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: Literal value to write. Mutually exclusive with ottl_value.

fields.name: ottl_value
fields.label: OTTL value
fields.description: OTTL expression evaluated in the applicable context. Mutually exclusive with value.

options.label: Upsert
options.description: Write unconditionally.

options.label: Update
options.description: Write only when the field already exists.

options.label: Insert
options.description: Write only when the field is absent.

help.summary: Add fields to telemetry records, when a condition holds.

definitions.description: Delete fields from telemetry records, when a condition holds.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: OTTL condition that has to hold for the fields to be deleted from a record. Without it, they are deleted from every record.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Where the fields live. With record, each name is an OTTL path that indexes a map, in the context of the record, such as attributes["env"] for a log, or a full path that starts with a context, such as log.attributes["env"].

fields.name: names
fields.label: Names
fields.description: Names of the fields to delete from the location. A name that starts with a bracket, such as ["labels"]["tier"], reaches into a map that is the value of a key.

help.summary: Delete fields from telemetry records, when a condition holds.

definitions.description: Drop records that match OTTL conditions.

fields.name: error_mode
fields.label: Default error mode
fields.description: Determines how errors that occur while evaluating a condition are treated. It is the default for every block.

options.label: Propagate
options.description: Stop and report the error. The payload is dropped.

options.label: Ignore
options.description: Log the error and carry on with the next condition.

options.label: Silent
options.description: Carry on with the next condition without logging the error.

fields.name: conditions
fields.label: Configurations
fields.description: The blocks of OTTL conditions. Data that matches any condition is dropped.

items.description: A block of conditions. Data is dropped when it matches any condition of any block.

fields.name: error_mode
fields.label: Error mode
fields.description: Overrides the default error mode.

options.label: Propagate
options.description: Stop and report the error. The payload is dropped.

options.label: Ignore
options.description: Log the error and carry on with the next condition.

options.label: Silent
options.description: Carry on with the next condition without logging the error.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Context
fields.description: Explicit OTTL context of the conditions. Leave it blank to automatically infer. The filter drops whole records, metrics and data points, so it has no exemplar context.

fields.name: conditions
fields.label: Conditions
fields.description: A list of OTTL conditions. The data that matches any of them is dropped.

help.summary: Drop records that match OTTL conditions.

definitions.description: Move fields of telemetry records to other fields, when a condition holds.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: OTTL condition that has to hold for the fields to be moved on a record. Without it, they are moved on every record.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Where the field lives now.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the field within the location, or an OTTL path for the record location. A name that starts with a bracket, such as ["labels"]["tier"], reaches into a map that is the value of a key.

fields.name: new_location
fields.label: New location
fields.description: Where the value goes.

fields.name: new_name
fields.label: New name
fields.description: Name of the field the value goes to, or an OTTL path for the record location.

help.summary: Move fields of telemetry records to other fields, when a condition holds.

definitions.description: Rename fields of telemetry records, when a condition holds.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: OTTL condition that has to hold for the fields to be renamed in a record. Without it, they are renamed in every record.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Where the field lives. With record, name and new_name are paths in the context of the record, as in set.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Name of the field within the location. With record, a path in the context of the record that indexes a map.

fields.name: new_name
fields.label: New name
fields.description: The new name of the field. A field that already has it is overwritten. With record, a path in the context of the record that indexes a map.

help.summary: Rename fields of telemetry records, when a condition holds.

fields.name: condition
fields.label: Condition
fields.description: OTTL condition that has to hold for the operations to run on a record. Without it, they run on every record.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Location
fields.description: Portable base location of the path. Omit it to write a full OTTL path, or a field of the document for docs.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Context
fields.description: Explicit OTTL context of the path. Not used together with location.

fields.name: path
fields.label: Path
fields.description: Field path within the location, or a full OTTL path when no location is set. For docs it is a field of the document.

fields.name: value
fields.label: Value
fields.description: Literal value to write. Mutually exclusive with ottl_value.

fields.name: ottl_value
fields.label: OTTL value
fields.description: OTTL expression evaluated in the applicable context. Mutually exclusive with value.

options.label: Upsert
options.description: Write unconditionally.

options.label: Update
options.description: Write only when the field already exists.

options.label: Insert
options.description: Write only when the field is absent.

definitions.description: Run OTTL statements on records, optionally guarded by conditions.

fields.name: error_mode
fields.label: Default error mode
fields.description: Determines how errors that occur while processing a statement are treated.

options.label: Propagate
options.description: Stop and report the error.

options.label: Ignore
options.description: Log the error and carry on with the next statement.

options.label: Silent
options.description: Carry on with the next statement without logging the error.

fields.name: statements
fields.label: Configurations
fields.description: The blocks of OTTL statements to run.

items.description: A group of statements with optional guard conditions. Blocks run in order, and a block sees the changes of the ones before it.

fields.name: error_mode
fields.label: Error mode
fields.description: Overrides the default error mode.

options.label: Propagate
options.description: Stop and report the error.

options.label: Ignore
options.description: Log the error and carry on with the next statement.

options.label: Silent
options.description: Carry on with the next statement without logging the error.

fields.name: context
fields.label: Context
fields.description: Explicit OTTL context of the path. Leave it blank to automatically infer.

fields.name: conditions
fields.label: Conditions
fields.description: A list comprised of multiple where clauses, which will be processed as global conditions for the accompanying set of statements.

fields.name: statements
fields.label: Statements
fields.description: A list of OTTL statements.

fields.name: shared_cache
fields.label: Shared cache
fields.description: Enables sharing per-context caches between all configuration with this option enabled. Use this when you want to hold state across multiple iterations over a set of data.

help.summary: Run OTTL statements on records, optionally guarded by conditions.

definitions.description: Writes records to one fixed Elasticsearch index or data stream per signal, or routes them dynamically when no index is set.

fields.name: index
fields.label: Index
fields.description: The index or data stream records are written to. It must be a fixed, lowercase name with no wildcards, templates or date math. Scope an entry to some signals to write each signal to its own index; a scoped entry takes precedence over an unscoped one. A signal without an index is routed dynamically by its elasticsearch.index or data_stream.* attributes.

fields.name: write_patterns
fields.label: Write patterns
fields.description: Index name patterns the destination may write to, with * wildcards such as logs-*-*. They describe the write scope of the destination's credential and do not change where records are routed. Scope an entry to some signals to set the patterns of those signals. Omit them to leave the scope to the credential.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.description: An Elasticsearch API key, for testing. Without it the key comes from the environment.

help.summary: Writes records to one fixed Elasticsearch index or data stream per signal, or routes them dynamically when no index is set.

definitions.description: Writes records to an Elasticsearch cluster on Elastic Cloud outside this deployment, with an API key the user brings.

fields.name: endpoint
fields.label: Endpoint
fields.description: The https URL of the remote Elasticsearch cluster, which must be an Elastic Cloud one.

fields.name: index
fields.label: Index
fields.description: The index or data stream records are written to. It must be a fixed, lowercase name with no wildcards, templates or date math. Scope an entry to some signals to write each signal to its own index; a scoped entry takes precedence over an unscoped one. A signal without an index is routed dynamically by its elasticsearch.index or data_stream.* attributes.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.description: An API key created on the remote cluster: a {credential: <name>} reference to a sealed credential passed with the unit, or a plaintext key for testing, which ends up in the compiled configuration. The key needs write access to the target indices.

help.summary: Writes records to an Elasticsearch cluster on Elastic Cloud outside this deployment, with an API key the user brings.
